map.根据过去两周内的感受自评7个焦虑症状条目，筛查广泛性焦虑严重程度。共7题，每题0: Self-rate 7 anxiety-symptom items based on feelings over the past two weeks to screen generalized anxiety severity. 7 items, 0-3 each.
map.GAD-7总分 = Σ7个条目（每项0-3，满分21）；≤4无焦虑、5-9轻度、: GAD-7 total = sum of 7 items (0-3 each, max 21); <=4 none, 5-9 mild, 10-14 moderate, >=15 severe.
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代精神科专业诊断。GAD-7总分≥10时其诊断敏感性: This is a self-help screening tool and does not replace psychiatric diagnosis. At GAD-7 total >=10 sensitivity is high; seek professional assessment.
map.7 项（完全不会0/好几天1/一半以上2/几乎每天3）：2,2,2,1,2,2,: 7 items (not at all 0 / several days 1 / more than half 2 / nearly every day 3): 2,2,2,1,2,2,1 = 12, moderate anxiety; psychotherapy advised, >=14 consider medication.
map.7 项全 3 → 21，重度，需尽快精神科评估并排查抑郁共病。: All 7 items 3 -> 21, severe; urgent psychiatric assessment and screen for depressive comorbidity.
map.0–4 无/最小，5–9 轻，10–14 中，15–21 重；第 2 题高分提示: 0-4 none/minimal, 5-9 mild, 10-14 moderate, 15-21 severe; high item-2 score suggests marked functional impairment.
map.不能，仅筛查与严重度监测，确诊需结构化临床访谈。: No; it only screens and monitors severity; confirmation needs structured clinical interview.
